title: Northgate Optical Lab Cost Note: Treated Lens Blanks
content:
On a Northgate Optical job cancelled in the lab, the lens blanks of a job carrying a light-adaptive or blue-light filtering charge have been treated, and a treated-blank deduction is kept from the material cancellation refund.

**Note.** Where a light-adaptive option charge was posted on the job, the blanks have been treated and a treated-blank deduction of 5.00 is kept; where no light-adaptive charge but a blue-light filtering charge was posted, the treated-blank deduction is 2.50. Where neither was posted, there is no treated-blank deduction.

| Light-adaptive charge posted on the job | Blue-light filtering charge posted on the job | Treated-blank deduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 5.00 |
| yes | no | 5.00 |
| no | yes | 2.50 |
| no | no | none |

**Records read.** The option charge entries of the job. A charge counts as posted whether or not a refund has since been credited against it; an anti-reflective coating charge does not enter this note.

### Examples (hypothetical jobs)

- Light-adaptive charge 80.00, refunded in full by a cancellation refund: the charge was posted, so 5.00.
- Blue-light filtering 30.00 and anti-reflective coating 35.00: 2.50.
- Anti-reflective coating only: none.
